description: This file defines a Flutter widget screen called CategoriesScreen, which displays a categorized shopping interface with custom styling and layout. It includes header, grid of category cards, and a bottom navigation bar.

classes.name: CategoriesScreen
classes.description: A Flutter widget representing the categories screen with various UI components, styling, and layout for browsing product categories.

classes.name: _CircleIconDot
classes.description: A small circular widget used as an icon dot in the header.

classes.name: _CartBagBox
classes.description: A placeholder widget representing a shopping bag icon.

classes.name: _Badge
classes.description: A widget for displaying a notification badge with a number.

classes.name: _BigTitle
classes.description: A widget displaying the main titles 'Shop' and 'By Category'.

classes.name: _CardRow
classes.description: A widget for arranging two category cards in a horizontal row.

classes.name: _IconVectors
classes.description: A simple data holder class referencing icon vector assets.

classes.name: _CategoryCard
classes.description: A widget representing a single category card with image placeholder, title, and subtitle.

classes.name: _Hairline
classes.description: A thin line used as a divider inside category cards.

classes.name: _BottomBar
classes.description: A widget simulating bottom navigation bar with icons and decoration.

classes.name: _RoundIcon
classes.description: A circular icon widget with tooltip and border, used in bottom navigation.

classes.name: _BottomTextIcon
classes.description: A column widget combining an icon button and label for bottom menu items.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for CategoriesScreen defining its entire widget tree.
